basic_details.job_title: East Champaran District Cout Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for three contractual support staff posts – one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly – in the Evening Court, East Champaran, Motihari. The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, East Champaran, Motihari (Bihar) has invited the applications, which must reach its office personally or through registered post on or before 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About East Champaran Civil Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, East Champaran, Motihari, the head of the Civil Courts in the district. The posts are support staff for the Evening Court at East Champaran, Motihari, and the notice has been circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar. Eligibility follows guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the following office on or before 30 November 2026: Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, East Champaran, Motihari Mode: either personally (by hand) or through registered post. The date is for receipt: the application must reach the office by 30.11.2026, not just be posted by then. The notice does not mention a prescribed application form, a fee or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records. The applicant should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. In addition to the common conditions, a Stenographer applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. In addition to the common conditions, a Clerk applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. In addition to the common conditions, a Peon/Orderly applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The notice prints no pay amount. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. The engagement is purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court, and the selected candidates shall be required to perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-wise eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in East Champaran Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly for the Evening Court, East Champaran, Motihari.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, East Champaran, Motihari on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply, and only those who retired within the preceding three years as per the guidelines issued by Hon'ble High Court, Patna.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application personally or through registered post to the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, East Champaran, Motihari, so that it reaches by 30.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is needed for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: A Stenographer applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing.

faq.question: Q6. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: A Clerk applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. Can a retired employee with a disciplinary record apply?
faq.answer: The applicant must have satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q9. When will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: The selected candidates shall be required to perform their duties during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court.
